what_happened: Cherry-pick replay onto origin/dev and origin/master caused heavy conflicts and wasted cycles.
root_cause: Assumed old commits were cleanly replayable despite branch-wide JS->TS and test evolution.
detection_signal: Conflicts across missing/renamed files and cross-system bridge dependencies during cherry-pick.
fix_applied: Switched to preserve-all forward cleanup from current HEAD and validated behavior directly via tests.
prevention_rule: Before replaying history, run a small feasibility probe and stop after first high-conflict signal; default to forward-slice cleanup when branch divergence is high.

what_happened: Navigation tests initially failed with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.
root_cause: Ran Selenium tests without local host running.
fix_applied: Started npm dev host and re-ran tests successfully.
prevention_rule: Treat dev host as a mandatory precondition for Selenium runs; start host first for all browser-flow test batches.
